data.name: Jabbad
data.gender_notes: Jabbad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'j-b-d', meaning 'to be generous or kind'. In Islamic history, Jabbad is associated with the virtues of kindness and generosity, as mentioned in several Hadiths. The name Jabbad carries the meaning “Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jabbad usually hope their child will grow to embody generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spirit of giving and kindness, reflecting the teachings of Islam.
data.etymology: Jabbad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabbad total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
